signing_key_provenance: ephemeral_ci_ed25519_keypair (private key destroyed immediately after signing; use p4-release.yml with protected CSKH_RELEASE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY for formal Go-Live cutover)

local_image_id.description: Docker daemon local image ID (.Id from docker image inspect; equals config digest on classic graphdriver store or manifest/index digest on containerd image store; analogous in class to baseline CI db925419...)

oci_config_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the OCI Image Configuration JSON blob (manifest.config.digest in manifest/oci-distribution-manifest.json)

registry_manifest_digest.description: Remote GHCR immutable distribution manifest digest (@sha256; analogous in class to baseline CI 36613468...). ONLY this digest is promoted across CI -> Staging -> Production.

unrelated_live_image_reference.rule: Live keeping a prior version before authorized cutover is NOT deployment drift; never deploy candidates to crm.hrpartner.vn or mutate live just to match CI, and never cross-compare local_image_id, oci_config_digest, and registry_manifest_digest.
